_comment: L1 plan Task 17: Mutopia engravings, sonatinas and sonatas (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-14-l1-curated-library.md). Facts from content/tools/candidates.json and the fetched RDF; retrievedAt is the fetch log's date. Syllabus sources: Henle levels of difficulty https://www.henle.de/Levels-of-Difficulty/ (level 3 is Beethoven Op. 49 No. 2), HN 848 https://www.henle.de/Six-Piano-Sonatinas-op.-36/HN-848, HN 1391 https://www.henle.de/en/Five-Easy-Piano-Sonatas/HN-1391, HN 1392 https://www.henle.de/en/Five-Famous-Piano-Sonatas/HN-1392, HN 1300 https://www.henle.de/en/Piano-Sonata-A-major-K.-331-Alla-Turca/HN-1300, ABRSM 2023-2024 Grade 6 list as given by https://www.online-academy.informance.biz/courses/10-a-guide-to-the-abrsm-syllabus-2023-2024-intermediate/132 (all retrieved 2026-10-14).

pieces.title: Sonatina in C major, 2nd movement (Andante)
pieces.tempoSource: LilyPond \midi block of the source (quarter = 92, inside the usual Andante range); the engraving prints Andante without a metronome mark
pieces.levelNote: Henle rates Sonatina Op. 36 No. 1 as a whole at 3, easy (HN 848; the plan maps Henle 3 near our 4); kept at 3 like the core 1st movement, the Andante being the sonatina's gentlest movement. Heuristic proposes 3.
pieces.notes: Second movement, in F major (the Mutopia file holds all three movements; the core library has the first). Engraved from the G. Schirmer Sonatina Album (1893).

pieces.title: Sonatina in C major, 3rd movement (Vivace)
pieces.tempoSource: LilyPond \midi block of the source (eighth = 160, that is quarter = 80: Vivace counted in eighths, a moderate study tempo); the engraving prints Vivace without a metronome mark
pieces.levelNote: Henle rates Sonatina Op. 36 No. 1 as a whole at 3, easy (HN 848; the plan maps Henle 3 near our 4); kept at 3 like the core 1st movement. Heuristic proposes 2 at the source's moderate tempo.
pieces.notes: Third movement (the Mutopia file holds all three movements; the core library has the first). Engraved from the G. Schirmer Sonatina Album (1893).

pieces.title: Sonatina in C major, 2nd movement (Andante)
pieces.tempoSource: LilyPond \midi block of the source (quarter = 72, dotted quarter = 48 in 6/8, a usual Andante); the engraving prints Andante without a metronome mark
pieces.levelNote: No published placement found for the Andante; the sonatina's 1st movement is ABRSM Grade 6 (2023-2024, list A), and this 16-bar slow movement is far shorter and slower. Heuristic proposes 3.
pieces.notes: Mutopia title 'Sonatine I - Andante'; in F major. Engraved from a 19th-century B. Schott's Söhne edition (Drei Sonatinen, Op. 20). The source's explicit end bar line (\bar "|.") at the start of the repeated second part, bar 8, is removed before conversion: it hid the repeat start, so the MusicXML had a repeat back to bar 1 instead of to the upbeat of bar 9; LilyPond now draws the start-repeat bar line there. Notes and MIDI are unchanged.

pieces.title: Sonatina in C major, 1st movement (Allegro)
pieces.tempoSource: LilyPond \midi block of the source (quarter = 120, a usual Allegro); the engraving prints Allegro without a metronome mark
pieces.levelNote: ABRSM Grade 6 (2023-2024 syllabus, list A: 'Allegro, 1st mvt from Sonatina in C, Op. 20 No. 1'), about our 4. Heuristic proposes 3.
pieces.notes: Mutopia title 'Sonatine I - Allegro'. Engraved from a 19th-century B. Schott's Söhne edition (Drei Sonatinen, Op. 20), including its fingerings.

pieces.title: Sonatina in C major, 3rd movement (Rondo: Allegro)
pieces.tempoSource: LilyPond \midi block of the source (quarter = 120, a usual Allegro in 2/4); the engraving prints Allegro without a metronome mark
pieces.levelNote: No published placement found for the Rondo; the same sonatina's 1st movement is ABRSM Grade 6 (2023-2024, list A), about our 4, and the Rondo is as fast and longer. Heuristic proposes 3.
pieces.notes: Mutopia title 'Sonatine I - Rondo'. Engraved from a 19th-century B. Schott's Söhne edition (Drei Sonatinen, Op. 20), including its fingerings.

pieces.title: Piano Sonata in C major ('Sonata facile'), 2nd movement (Andante, theme)
pieces.excerpt: Bars 1-32 of 74: the theme section, two repeated halves that both end on the tonic (G major); the G minor middle section, the return and the coda are left out. The whole movement plays 5:18 with its repeats at the default tempo, over the 4:15 limit.
pieces.tempoSource: LilyPond \midi block of the source (quarter = 60, a usual Andante); the engraving prints Andante without a metronome mark
pieces.levelNote: No per-movement placement verified; same sonata as the core 1st movement (level 4), with the same Alberti left hand under a decorated cantabile line. Heuristic proposes 3.
pieces.notes: Mutopia title 'Sonata Facile - Second movement'. Engraved from an IMSLP scan (edition not named), including its fingerings. The engraving is CC BY-SA 3.0 (attribution: Alejandro Sierra / Mutopia Project); this MusicXML is shared under the same license.

pieces.title: Piano Sonata in C major ('Sonata facile'), 3rd movement (Rondo: Allegretto)
pieces.tempoSource: LilyPond \midi block of the source (quarter = 104, a usual Allegretto in 2/4); the engraving prints no metronome mark
pieces.levelNote: No per-movement placement verified; same sonata as the core 1st movement (level 4), with sixteenth-note passage work in both hands. Heuristic proposes 3.
pieces.notes: Mutopia title 'Sonata Facile - Third movement'. Engraved from an IMSLP scan (edition not named), including its fingerings. The engraving is CC BY-SA 3.0 (attribution: Alejandro Sierra / Mutopia Project); this MusicXML is shared under the same license. Two left-hand slurs that start inside a two-voice passage and end in the main voice (a phrasing slur in bars 15-16 and a slur in bars 46-47) were removed before conversion: LilyPond 2.24 cannot end such a slur and drops it from its own engraving ('unterminated slur'), and the killed slur crashed the converter's dump engraver. Notes and MIDI are unchanged.

pieces.title: Sonata in G major, 2nd movement (Tempo di Menuetto)
pieces.tempoSource: LilyPond \midi block of the source (quarter = 134, a brisk but usual Tempo di Menuetto); the engraving prints Tempo di Menuetto without a metronome mark
pieces.levelNote: Henle 3 (easy) for Sonata Op. 49 No. 2 (HN 1391; Henle's own example of level 3), which the plan maps to our 4. Heuristic proposes 3.
pieces.notes: Mutopia title 'Sonata No. 20 (2nd Movement: Tempo di Menuetto)'. Composed 1795-96, published 1805. Engraved from the Breitkopf & Härtel complete edition (1862-1865).

pieces.title: Sonata in G minor, 1st movement (Andante)
pieces.tempoSource: the source's own \tempo 4 = 98, not printed (quarter = 98, inside the usual Andante range); the engraving prints Andante without a metronome mark
pieces.levelNote: Henle 3 (easy) for Sonata Op. 49 No. 1 (HN 1391), which the plan maps to our 4. Heuristic proposes 3.
pieces.notes: Mutopia title 'Sonata No. 19 (1st Movement: Andante)'. Composed 1796-98, published 1805. Engraved from the Breitkopf & Härtel complete edition (1862-1865). The plan's first level-4 spare, used in place of haydn-sonata-hob-xvi-27-mvt2 (rejected below). The six delayed turns, which the engraving draws as a turn glyph in a text markup between a dotted eighth and its sixteenth (bars 17, 19, 21, 22, 25 and 88), are left out: the converter would print them as the words 'scripts.turn' and has no delayed-turn ornament. The notes and the MIDI are unaffected.

pieces.title: Rondo alla Turca (Piano Sonata in A major, 3rd movement)
pieces.tempoSource: editorial: quarter = 120, the lower end of usual Allegretto tempos for this rondo; the source has no tempo (its empty \midi block plays LilyPond's default quarter = 60), and the engraving prints Allegretto without a metronome mark
pieces.levelNote: Henle 6 (medium) and ABRSM Grade 8 for Sonata K. 331 (HN 1300), above the Henle 4 that the plan maps to our 5. Heuristic proposes 3 (score 8.92, just under the level-4 cut).
pieces.levelOverride: The heuristic proposes 3, but Henle rates the sonata 6 and ABRSM sets it at Grade 8 (HN 1300). Note density is measured at the moderate default tempo, and the heuristic has no feature for the right hand's octaves and broken octaves in the A major refrain.
pieces.notes: Mutopia title 'Sonate Opus KV 331 - Rondo Alla Turca'. Complete movement (3:28 with its repeats at the default tempo). Engraved from an IMSLP scan (edition not named), including its fingerings. The source is a zip of two files: KV331_3_RondoAllaTurca.ly includes KV331_3_RondoAllaTurcaNotes.ly (SHA-256 281da85484e82f2c874d8ab6d710868b70b54d44b3a01b5b7d396b4086125d89); sourceSha256 is that of the main .ly, and the zip's is ac2eba084c584b5e820e8a4554efdf630fa63e661b61ad064a85c041ce92fb24.

pieces.title: Piano Sonata No. 8 'Pathétique', 2nd movement (Adagio cantabile, opening)
pieces.excerpt: Bars 1-16 of 73: the theme and its restatement an octave higher, ending on the tonic (A-flat major); the last bar keeps its run-up into the first episode.
pieces.tempoSource: the source's own hidden \tempo 4 = 36 (eighth = 72, a usual Adagio); the engraving prints Adagio cantabile without a metronome mark
pieces.levelNote: Henle 7 (difficult) for Sonata Op. 13 (HN 1392); an opening of its slow movement, like the core Moonlight opening (also a Henle 7 sonata) at level 5. Heuristic proposes 3.
pieces.levelOverride: The heuristic proposes 3 because the Adagio is slow (5 notes per second), but Henle rates the sonata 7 (HN 1392), and in bars 1-8 the right hand sings the melody over its own semiquaver accompaniment, voicing the heuristic does not measure; the core Moonlight opening is level 5 for the same reason.
pieces.notes: Mutopia title 'Sonata No. 8 “Pathétique” (2nd Movement: Adagio cantabile)'. Engraved by Chris Sawer from the Berners edition (1908, ed. A. Winterberger), with fingerings and dynamics added by Javier Ruiz-Alma from the Köhler and Ruthardt Peters edition (1910), including those fingerings.

rejected.reason: Converted exactly (LilyPond 2.24 MIDI 637/637), but fails the span and lint gates: two span-flagged slices (bar 29 left hand G2 G3 B3 and bar 31 right hand G4 G5 B5, 16 semitones: cross-staff passages, where the staff-based hand assignment gives notes of both hands to one hand) and L05 law errors (9 at medium, 7 at large) in bars 29, 31, 44, 46, 60 and 62. The Menuetto's first part ends in D major at bar 16, so no section of at least 16 bars ends on the tonic before bar 29; it also plays 4:18 with its repeats at the source's tempo. Dropped; replaced by the spare beethoven-sonata-op49-no1-mvt1.
Spare, trial-built only (not needed after beethoven-sonata-op49-no1-mvt1 passed): the LilyPond 2.24 MIDI check is not exact (2 notes only in the MIDI).
Spare, trial-built only (not needed): one L03 law error at medium and a LilyPond 2.24 MIDI check that is not exact (1 note only in the MIDI).
